purpose: Advance Operation SLEUTH through 27 Feb while preserving cue/track/weapon-quality distinctions and without treating theoretical aircraft radius as guaranteed search coverage.
rules: Within aircraft radius is not equivalent to searched coverage.
A stale or uncorrelated cue does not release an anti-shipping strike.
Embarked Illustrious aircraft cannot also be credited ashore in Ceylon.
Known post-27 outcomes do not back-propagate into this window.

chronology.RN_state: Illustrious + Gambia + Rotherham + Tjerk Hiddes continue south/southeast on SLEUTH. Ceylon heavy battle squadron remains harbour/escort constrained.
chronology.carrier_air: Routine CAP, A/S patrol and blockade-runner search; no strike target.
chronology.Japan_search: 705th Sumatra search system receives no precise route cue; broad southwest search allocation remains sparse.
chronology.contact_result: NO Japanese maintained datum on SLEUTH.
chronology.decision: Oyodo group remains reserve; no second reinforcement gate.

chronology.RN_state: At 1153FG near 02-57S 88-19E, Rotherham and Tjerk Hiddes detach for Addu. Illustrious and Gambia continue the operation with temporarily reduced close surface screen.
chronology.carrier_air: A/S patrol share is raised inside the available deck cycle because close destroyer screen is thinner; blockade-runner search continues.
chronology.Japan_search: The force is about 680 nmi from Sabang, inside G4M ferry/search radius but near the outer end of useful search geometry. With only 4-8 long-range searches/day spread over multiple lanes and no precise cue, no visual contact is credited.
chronology.contact_result: NO cue maturation; NO Japanese air strike.

chronology.RN_state: Illustrious + Gambia continue searching southwest of the Cocos approach. Sussex sails from Fremantle to join but is not yet present.
chronology.Japan_search: No fresh contact. 705th remains capable of long-range search but cannot infer the carrier track from silence.
chronology.decision: No Japanese carrier-response or surface interception release.

chronology.RN_state: SLEUTH continues without finding the suspected German surface blockade runner. Thin-screen carrier posture persists; deck ASW/CAP remains emphasized.
chronology.subwar_interlock: I-37 sinks Sutlej far to the west near 08S 70E; this shipping attack is geographically independent and does not cue SLEUTH.

chronology.RN_state: Illustrious + Gambia remain at sea on SLEUTH. Sussex is still en route and will not join until 28 Feb, outside this window.
chronology.Japan_state: No SLEUTH contact is available to the Oyodo reserve. A separate Japanese commerce-raiding movement (SA No.1) begins from Lingga/Singapore and is accounted independently.
chronology.contact_result: SLEUTH remains undetected at weapon-quality level through 27T24.

historical_anchors: Eastern Fleet diary: capital ships remained harbour-constrained 25-29 Feb for lack of destroyers.
Operation SLEUTH: Rotherham and Tjerk Hiddes detached to Addu at 1153FG/24 in 02-57S 88-19E; Sussex sailed Fremantle 25 Feb and joined only on 28 Feb.
